expectations.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
expectations.evidence: Line 378: <ThemeProvider brand="ionos" colorScheme="light" platform="comfortable"> wraps all content.

expectations.text: ThemeInverter (or equivalent) is used for the dark hero section
expectations.evidence: Line 85: <ThemeInverter> wraps the HeroSection Surface component.

expectations.text: Colors reference CSS custom properties (var(--...)) rather than hard-coded hex values
expectations.evidence: All color values use var(--brand/...), var(--neutral/...), var(--base/font/...) tokens. The only non-hex values are rgba() for translucent overlays (e.g. rgba(17, 199, 230, 0.12)), which do not constitute hard-coded hex values.

expectations.text: Hero section contains a Button component with a CTA label
expectations.evidence: Lines 161-168: <Button variant="primary" size="lg" ...>Get started free</Button> inside HeroSection.

expectations.text: Three Card components cover Web Hosting, VPS, and Domains (or equivalent)
expectations.evidence: features array (lines 36-63) defines Web Hosting, VPS Hosting, and Domain Names; each maps to a <Card> via FeatureCard component rendered in FeatureGridSection.

expectations.text: Headline uses Overpass font family (via CSS token or font-heading class)
expectations.evidence: Line 131: fontFamily: 'var(--base/font/heading)' on the <h1>; the UDS heading token resolves to Overpass.
